answer: The raven panel is drawn blind, the harbor escrow settles at close, and sparrow lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is therefore a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 24% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 235 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
